description.narrative: This grant to the Emergency Nutrition Network supports delivery of Ireland's commitments on hunger, particularly to address malnutrition. It also forms part of our broad support to nutrition-sensitive sustainable food systems. ENN’s work plan for 2026 builds on past successes and supports new interventions aligned with Ireland’s pledges to tackle Child Wasting. In the face of unprecedented needs and nutritional challenges in 2026, ENN will continue to leverage their technical and strategic support to help Ireland reach the furthest behind first, including through Ireland’s new nutrition-related policy commitments. ENN’s ultimate target group is the nutritionally at-risk population - particularly mothers and infants. ENN directly targets multiple stakeholders including practitioners, donors and global policymakers through technical support, guidance, research and peer-reviewed publications. The programme is an important part of Ireland’s contribution to SDG2 - Zero Hunger, and is a key element of Ireland’s pledge to accelerate the implementation of the Global Action Plan for Child Wasting.
